taskDescription: Analyze the merger agreement and identify all representations and warranties made by the target company, highlighting any that are qualified by materiality.

rubricMatrix.title: Identifies all material reps and warranties
Cites section numbers for each rep

rubricDetails.title: Correctly identifies materiality qualifiers
rubricDetails.matchCriteria: The response must correctly identify and explain all materiality-qualified representations, including the standard used (e.g., Material Adverse Effect definition).

perRun.reasoning: The agent correctly identified all seven materiality-qualified representations and cited the MAE definition from Section 1.1.
The agent identified only four of seven materiality-qualified representations and did not cite the MAE definition.
perRun.judgeFlagReason: Criterion may be under-specified regarding which sections constitute materiality qualifiers.

perRun.reasoning: The agent conflated materiality qualifiers with knowledge qualifiers in three instances.

rubricDetails.title: Distinguishes operating and financial reps
rubricDetails.matchCriteria: The response must clearly separate operational representations (business conduct, IP, employees) from financial representations (financial statements, tax, debt).

perRun.reasoning: The agent did not clearly separate the categories; tax representations were listed under operating instead of financial.
The agent produced a flat list without categorisation.
perRun.judgeFlagReason: This criterion was added post-task and may not match the original instructions.

perRun.reasoning: The agent correctly separated all representations into the two required categories.

rubricDetails.title: Cites section numbers for each rep
rubricDetails.matchCriteria: Every identified representation must include the section number from the merger agreement where it appears.

perRun.reasoning: All representations were accompanied by precise section references.
Section references were omitted entirely from the response.

rubricDetails.title: Summarises survival periods
rubricDetails.matchCriteria: The response must include the survival period for each representation as stated in the merger agreement's indemnification section.

perRun.reasoning: All survival periods correctly summarised with reference to Section 9.1.
Survival periods correctly noted; fundamental reps correctly identified as surviving indefinitely.
